definitions: The belief that knowledge of God or ultimate reality can be attained through spiritual apprehension.
A system of contemplative prayer and practice directed at achieving direct experience of the divine.
Vague or ill-defined religious or spiritual belief, especially when associated with a belief in the supernatural.
examples: She delved into the study of Eastern mysticism.
His poetry is often imbued with a sense of mysticism.
The ancient texts are full of references to mysticism.
